newsitem.title: USA: St Louis mayor reappoints airports director.
newsitem.headline: St Louis mayor reappoints airports director.

text.p: St. Louis Mayor Clarence Harmon has reappointed airports director Leonard Griggs in one of his first announcements after assuming office this week.
Harmon took office Tuesday and on Wednesday announced a number of appointments and reappointments to high city posts.

Harmon had campaigned in part on requiring St. Louis officials to live in the city. While Griggs does not currently live in St. Louis, he has pledged to move into the city, a spokeswoman for Harmon said.
Griggs is director of Lambert-St. Louis International Airport and chairman of the St. Louis Airport Commission.
The city is currently awaiting a final environmental impact statement from the Federal Aviation Administration for its proposed $1.88 billion expansion of Lambert, which serves as a hub for TWA.
